steering_servo.note: Acts at the pitman (steering-box output); with the 6:1 box, 80 N m there is 13 N m at the steering wheel.

suspension.note: Semi-elliptic leaf springs as linear springs on the axle joints: front 60 kN/m heave, rear 80 kN/m heave (as a moment about the radius-rod pivot), roll from 0.76 m spring spacing, light damping (interleaf friction). Spring preload (springref) is calibrated at run time so the loaded car sits at the design ride height.
suspension.damping_note: Damping doubled to about 0.3 of critical (leaf-spring interleaf friction): at 0.15 a 40 mm road bump at 15 km/h put the axles 2-4% onto their bump stops.
suspension.rear_note: Rear rate raised 30% (104 kN/m heave equivalent) after the 40 mm bump touched the rear bump stops at 101.5% of the 45 mm travel; static deflection stays within the plausible band.

tire.note: Pneumatic tyres, 90 mm front / 120 mm rear (Wikipedia): shared compliant contact (k 2300 s^-2, b 48 s^-1 per unit mass), round crown 50 mm half-width.

assumptions: Mass split, centre of mass (front engine), inertia, spring rates and damping are estimates.
